The '''2018–19 Washington Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Washington]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies, led by second-year head coach [[Mike Hopkins (basketball)|Mike Hopkins]], played their home games at [[Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion]] in [[Seattle|Seattle, Washington]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 27–9, 15–3 in [[2018–19 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to win the regular season championship. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2019 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], where they lost to [[2018–19 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where, as a No. 9 seed, they defeated No. 8 seed [[2018–19 Utah State Aggies men's basketball team|Utah State]] in the first round before losing to No. 1 seed [[2018–19 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the second round.

==Previous season==
The [[2017–18 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|2017–18 season]] 21–13, 10–8 in [[2017–18 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12]] play to finish in a tie for sixth place. They lost to [[2017-18 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]] in the first round of the [[2018 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Oregon State defeats Washington in overtime in Pac-12 Tournament opener|url=http://www.spokesman.com/stories/2018/mar/07/oregon-state-defeats-washington-in-overtime-in-pac|website=The Spokesman-Review|access-date=7 March 2018}}</ref> They received an invitation to the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Washington Huskies land NIT invite, will host Boise State|url=http://www.spokesman.com/stories/2018/mar/11/washington-huskies-land-nit-invite-will-host-boise|website=The Spokesman-Review|access-date=11 March 2018}}</ref> where they defeated [[2017–18 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Boise State]] in the first round<ref>{{cite web|title=NIT: Washington holds off Boise State at NIT|url=http://www.lmtribune.com/sports/nit-washington-holds-off-boise-state-at-nit/article_e8e8e7b6-e62a-5761-a4fc-3707c185948c.html|website=The Lewiston Tribune|access-date=15 March 2018}}</ref> before losing to [[2017–18 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] in the second round.<ref>{{cite web|title=Saint Mary's moves on in NIT, beats Washington 85-81|url=http://komonews.com/sports/huskies/saint-marys-moves-on-in-nit-beats-washington-85-81|website=KOMO News|date=March 19, 2018 |access-date=19 March 2018}}</ref>
